description: React component for displaying and managing exam download options, including version detection, prerequisites, and download links, within the freeCodeCamp project.

methods.name: normalizeArch
methods.description: Normalizes architecture names extracted from file names to standard identifiers ('arm', 'x64', 'x86').

methods.name: handleDownloadLink
methods.description: Selects appropriate download link based on user's OS and architecture, prioritizing certain file extensions.

methods.name: ShowExamDownload
methods.description: Main React component for displaying exam download options, version info, prerequisites, and related actions.

methods.name: getRecommendedOs
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the recommended OS based on architecture and file extension.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Determines the latest release based on environment and release properties.
